Tío Luis —

Marcus and I are taking the kids to Cancún October 12–19. Any chance you can fly over from San José for a few days and meet the family?

We could do lunch on the 14th or 15th, or a beach morning if that's easier. Just you — we are not looping in the rest of the cousins on this.

— Priya
